artifacts.summary: Maintenance review of VU Amsterdam student examinations guidance verified a genuine policy-content update updated on September 16, 2026. The guidance expanded beyond Microsoft Copilot to formally authorize Google Gemini and Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) under Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals, forbidding human moderation review or model training on chats when logged in with VU credentials, while prohibiting instructors from requiring unlicensed AI tools.

artifacts.claimText: VU Amsterdam student examinations guidance establishes that instructors cannot require students to use unlicensed AI applications (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Grok), while identifying authorized tools covered by formal institutional data processing agreements: Microsoft Copilot for Web, Google Gemini and Gemini Notebook (under Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals), Cogniti on Azure, and integrated didactical tools (Canvas, FeedbackFruits, Writefull), provided students log in with VU credentials and never submit sensitive personal or research data.
artifacts.normalizedValue: Teachers cannot require unlicensed AI tools; formal data processing agreements cover VU-licensed Microsoft Copilot for Web, Google Gemini / Gemini Notebook, and Cogniti, with no human chat review or model training when logged in with VU credentials.

artifacts.evidenceSnippetOriginal: VU Amsterdam has a contract and a data processing agreement with the supplier Google. These contain all kinds of provisions that prohibit the supplier from using personal data of VU employees and VU students for their own purposes, such as reselling. Gemini and Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) are core services covered by the Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals Terms of Service. If you use your Google Workspace for Education account with Gemini and Gemini Notebook, your chats will not be reviewed by human moderators and will not be used in any other way to improve generative AI models. To use this chatbot securely, log in with your VU credentials.
